svg.text: SEEN FROM THE ROOM · ENTRANCE DOOR D1 ON THE LEFT · STUDY BOOKCASE END ON THE RIGHT · DASHED LINE = PARTITION (APPROX.)
EVERY IDEA CARRIES THE STUDY COUNTER LINE (570–610) ALONG THE WALL · SIZES AND DOOR POSITION ARE ESTIMATES
Quiet and symmetrical — both side walls match, the desk and shelves stay the stars
Milan / Paris 1930s — full-height fluted teak above the counter line; echoes the reeds on the desk
1930s ocean-liner glamour — smoky mirror in slim frames; doubles the window light and the bookcase
In the manner of Sert's 1930s murals — one landscape running behind the panel mouldings, sepia on gold
1940s Hollywood / Jean-Michel Frank — fabric or leather panels with brass nailheads; soft and quiet for the bed side
Jean-Michel Frank's Paris, 1930s — a grid of vellum-toned squares above the counter line; pale, rich, very quiet
